name: get_tests_for
title: Tests for code
description: Tests mapped to symbols or files. Direct mappings (depth 0) come from test-to-code mapping, with the evidence behind each one (a call from the test, an import, or a naming convention) and its resolution level. via_callers adds tests that reach the target through callers, up to that many hops, marked by their depth. Order: target as passed, then depth, then strongest resolution, then id.

repo.description: Registered repository name. Optional: defaults to the repository that contains the server's working directory, or the only registered one.

targets.description: Symbol or file IDs, or path:line locators.

via_callers.description: Also find tests that reach the target through up to this many callers.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; keep the other arguments the same.

depth.description: 0 for a direct mapping; otherwise the callers between the test and the target.

pending.description: Present when an edge behind the mapping awaits SCIP re-resolution.
